purpose: Route publications released after the primary DESI/DES measurements as methodological controls or adversarial comparator candidates without counting reanalysis of the same datasets as independent new data.

controls.title: Dynamical Dark Energy from DESI DR2 and DES Year 6 BAO, Supernovae and Cosmic Chronometers: A 3σ Preference Without Decisive Bayesian Evidence
controls.crosswalk: A frequentist-scale preference and Bayesian model evidence can disagree; RLL must not promote sigma-level preference into Bayes support.

controls.title: Constraints on coupled dark energy in the DESI era
controls.crosswalk: Interacting/coupled dark-energy alternatives remain relevant comparators when the same frozen likelihood can be reproduced; their published fit is not evidence for an RLL interaction sector.

controls.title: Testing the Anton-Schmidt dark energy model with the DESI DR2 measurements
controls.crosswalk: Published Bayesian preference for another dynamical-DE model is an adversarial model-selection target; no Bayes factor is imported until its likelihood, priors and evidence computation are independently reproducible under the RLL parity contract.

new comparator classes are visible to G4/G6 without being promoted

prior/evidence parity for any imported Bayes comparison
